description: Civgraph persons linked to the Wikidata item of the same person: MPs for Irish and Northern Irish seats, TDs, senators (Seanad Éireann, Senate of Northern Ireland), Stormont MPs, MLAs (1973, 1982 and 1998 assemblies), MEPs and councillors in Northern Ireland and the Republic. Keyed by Civgraph person id; each link carries its confidence and the evidence for it. Read by the Browse person records (scripts/lib/wikidata-persons.mjs) as the person's Wikidata link and JSON-LD sameAs where the official ids give none. Items reaching two or more Civgraph persons are listed under mergeLeads with a verdict; nothing here merges or splits a person. Supersedes wikidata-councillors.json (its 100 links and the review's 13 accepted ones are included).

source.title: Wikidata
source.also: English Wikipedia API (page to item, for the Wikipedia titles the registry holds)

confidence.official: an id Civgraph already holds names the item: a wikidata: official id, an official id (Oireachtas P4690, NI Assembly P5870, parliament.uk P10428, Democracy Club P6465, History of Parliament P1614) Wikidata gives to that item alone, or the registry's Wikipedia title. A date mismatch is accepted and noted.
confidence.high: the names agree and a dated Wikidata P39 statement of the same office covers a Civgraph election the person won, its P768 district naming the Civgraph constituency (or two dated statements agree); or a council link the ledger rated high.
confidence.medium: the names agree and one dated office statement without a district match, or an undated statement whose district matches; an undated single office only when the pairing is one-to-one, the name exact and there is no rival item; senators where a Civgraph candidacy in the same jurisdiction lies within 15 years of the term.

method.rejected: a Wikidata death before a Civgraph candidacy, or a birth giving an age under 18 at one (placeholder births such as 1 January 2000 ignored), unless an official id corroborates the link.
method.oneToOne: one item is linked to one person and one person to one item; an item reaching two or more persons is a merge lead, linked to none of them unless official ids pick exactly one.
method.scripts: built by the wikidata-all stream (11 Nov 2026): pop.py, harvest.py, match.py, finalize.py; re-run match.py and finalize.py after a person-id re-stamp
